summary: ICICI Bank filed a Form 6-K disclosing that its insurance subsidiary ICICI Life Insurance Limited (formerly ICICI Prudential Life) recorded the resignation of Managing Director and CEO Anup Bagchi effective close of business October 13, 2026, and approved Sidharatha Mishra as COO from October 6, 2026, and as MD and CEO from October 14, 2026, or IRDAI approval if later, for five years. Mishra transfers from ICICI Bank, ceasing to be Senior Management Personnel on October 5, 2026. No deal terms, price, or advisors are stated; the event concerns governance succession only. Watch for IRDAI approval timing and any strategic shift under new leadership.
